title: Something he buried there, his grandmother
html_source:
Alluding to Stephen’s riddle in Chapter 2:

The cock crew,
The sky was blue:
The bells in heaven
Were striking eleven.
‘Tis time for this poor soul
To go to heaven.

Where the answer is:

A fox burying it’s Grandmother under a holly bush.

This association in Stephen’s mind again causes him to drift off into a previous memory of a dream.

It is also interesting to note in this paragraph, and the two preceding it, that the dog undergoes some interesting changes in Stephen’s mind to various heraldic animals. This fits with the general protean theme of the Chapter.
